resources.string: Connect to your ORION — at home or away

On the same Wi-Fi as the PC, enter the home address shown in SECURITY → PAIR PHONE (port 8765); no Tailscale is needed and the phone asks for the PC\'s certificate code once. Away from home, a MagicDNS address needs Tailscale on this phone; a temporary trycloudflare.com address does not.
HTTPS only: port 8765 for the home Wi-Fi link (its certificate is pinned), 443 for Tailscale Serve or a tunnel.
Enter an HTTPS address. Plain HTTP is disabled.
Enter the HTTPS MagicDNS name instead of a 100.x address.
1. Start ORION on the PC with phone access on.\n2. Enter its home Wi-Fi address (or its Tailscale Serve / tunnel HTTPS URL).\n3. Pair with the code in the ORION Security Centre.
Enter the PC address ORION shows in his log
Enter a valid HTTPS host name.
Port must be a number from 1 to 65535
ORION answered, but the app page did not finish loading within 20 seconds. Check this address and try again.
Couldn\'t reach ORION.\nCheck that he is running, this phone has a network connection, and the selected HTTPS route is active.
Check the trusted HTTPS URL printed by the PC and confirm the route is active.
ORION may be serving HTTPS. Switch on \"Use HTTPS\" under Change server.
The HTTPS certificate could not be verified. On home Wi-Fi it must be the PC certificate you confirmed; otherwise use a valid Tailscale Serve or other trusted HTTPS address.
Enter the one-time pairing code shown on the ORION desktop.
Microphone is off for ORION. Allow it in Settings › Apps › ORION › Permissions to talk to him.
Authorisation expired. Ask ORION to try again.
ORION can read visible screen labels and carry out gestures only when you enable Accessibility in Android settings and approve each remote request in the app.
